requirement.description: The CI/CD pipeline is broken. That is simply how the CI/CD pipeline is working today.
requirement.reading: That is simply how the CI/CD pipeline is working today.

narrator.name: Automation Alex
narrator.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: {automation_alex} noted that the CI/CD pipeline for the Shelfcast forecasting service is currently broken. The automated build and deployment steps stopped functioning after the last infrastructure update. The team no longer relies on the pipeline to push model updates. Instead, engineers manually trigger the build process from their local machines and copy the resulting artifacts to the staging environment by hand. This manual procedure is the standard practice for releasing new model versions right now. The pipeline remains configured in the repository, but no automated runs have completed successfully since the incident. {automation_alex.first} confirmed that the workaround is stable for the immediate term, though it requires direct intervention from the engineering staff for every single deployment.
output.reclassify_reason: The artifact describes the current operational state and manual workaround without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs regarding what the team is willing to give up or accept.
